headline: Nigerian Domestic Airfares Jump Up to 200% Ahead of Festive Holiday Surge
summary: Airlines operating in Nigeria raised one-way fares up to 200% on routes to the country's South-East as holiday passenger travel demand surged ahead of the end-of-year season.
why: Air transport pricing in Nigeria is highly sensitive to jet fuel inflation, foreign currency scarcity, and seasonal domestic demand spikes.

impacts.name: Airlines
impacts.why: Higher ticket prices boost yield revenue per seat kilometer during peak seasonal passenger traffic.
